issue.title: Should stop bubbling event when event binding returns falsey

labels.name: area: core
labels.description: Issues related to the framework runtime

issue.body:
The following saves twice when I click the button ```
``` This is so regardless of what `onSave()` returns. @vsavkin responded: > I think we just call preventDefault but do not stop the bubbling. I might have misled you previously. > I am actually surprised we do not stop bubbling there > Seems reasonable to do it I think it is a matter of Angular honoring the `preventDefault` flag.

body: Might be.  Victor seemed to think it was setting `preventDefault` ... which isn't the same thing as honoring it in our A2 event handling. Interesting that this reads "... no longer ...".  I couldn't find an alpha in which it worked.
@wardbell It used to work a long time ago I think, in alpha-2x, but it doesn't anymore, I think since `(^click)` has become useless to handle bubbling events.
This is supposed to work (there is even a test). The problem seems to be with the evaluation of a chained expression (`setupAuthToken() && false` should work)
